answer.reason: NEH 8:7 and NEH 9:4-5 state deeds of this Levite beyond the summary: helping the people understand the law and leading the people in worship.

clauses.english: helped the people understand the law as it was read
clauses.quote: caused the people to understand the law

clauses.english: stood on the stairs and cried to the LORD, and called the people to bless him
clauses.quote: Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever

doubts: EZR 2:40, NEH 7:43 and NEH 12:8 may name this Levite or an earlier namesake, so they are not used; NEH 12:10 names a Jeshua who begat Joiakim, possibly another man, also left out.
